title: Teaming up for a lab report
objectives: Invite a classmate to work together
Agree on who will do which part
Agree on a time and place to combine the work

courseTemplate.setting: The report is due Friday. A study room is available Thursday evening.

roles.learner: A student looking for a lab partner
roles.partner: A classmate who can share the work

courseTemplate.openingLine: Hey! Have you found a partner for the lab report yet?

targetPatterns.pattern: Not yet. Would you like to team up?
targetPatterns.example: Not yet. Would you like to team up?

targetPatterns.pattern: Yes, I'll write the introduction while you analyse the data.
targetPatterns.example: Yes, I'll write the introduction while you analyse the data.

targetPatterns.pattern: Let's meet in a study room on Thursday evening.
targetPatterns.example: Let's meet in a study room on Thursday evening.

targetPatterns.pattern: Are you also in Professor Lee's econ class?
targetPatterns.example: Are you also in Professor Lee's econ class?
targetPatterns.translation: 你也在上 Lee 教授的经济学吗？

targetPatterns.pattern: Could I borrow your notes from Monday?
targetPatterns.example: Could I borrow your notes from Monday?

targetPatterns.pattern: Want to form a study group for the midterm?
targetPatterns.example: Want to form a study group for the midterm?
targetPatterns.translation: 要组个期中复习小组吗？

targetPatterns.pattern: How did you find the exam?
targetPatterns.example: How did you find the exam?

targetPatterns.pattern: Are you joining any clubs this semester?
targetPatterns.example: Are you joining any clubs this semester?
targetPatterns.translation: 这学期你会参加什么社团吗？

targetPatterns.pattern: We could split the work — two parts each.
targetPatterns.example: We could split the work — two parts each.
targetPatterns.translation: 我们可以分摊，一人两部分。

stages.title: Invite a classmate to work together
stages.instruction: Use the course facts to invite this task. A natural prompt is “Hey! Have you found a partner for the lab report yet?”
successCriteria: The learner can invite a classmate to work together in their own words.
hints: You can start with “Not yet. Would you …”

stages.title: Agree on who will do which part
stages.instruction: Use the course facts to invite this task. A natural prompt is “Sure. I can analyse the data. Could you write the introduction?”
successCriteria: The learner can agree on who will do which part in their own words.
hints: You can start with “Yes, I'll write the …”

stages.title: Agree on a time and place to combine the work
stages.instruction: Use the course facts to invite this task. A natural prompt is “When should we put everything together?”
successCriteria: The learner can agree on a time and place to combine the work in their own words.
hints: You can start with “Let's meet in a …”
